article.title: How to make better decisions?
article.excerpt: I never thought of this method : What should you do when you really, REALLY have to “go”? Make important life decisions, maybe. Controlling your bladder makes you better at controlling yourself when making decisions about your future, too, according to a study to be published in Psychological Science , a journal of the Association for Psychological Science.

article.title: How to get a macho guy to give in
article.excerpt: Researchers at the University of Leuven in Belgium asked men to play an ultimatum game , in which they split a certain amount of money between them. High-testosterone men drove the hardest bargain – unless they had previously viewed pictures of bikini-clad models, in which case they were more likely to accept a poorer deal.
